mission: Give the owner one truthful view of every engineering gap, sandbox/build stage, business-readiness gate and system-wide release status.

system_build_status.red: release-blocking build/security/data-loss/payment or deployment failure exists
system_build_status.yellow: no critical blocker, but required tests/evidence/gaps remain
system_build_status.green: all required current release gates pass with no known release blocker

truth_rule: Percent complete measures required evidence stages, not developer optimism. A gap cannot reach 100% until runtime evidence passes.
